dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Smooth, continuous 2D narrowing of the visible body mass from the mid-section toward a thin posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Lateral margins are smooth and highly symmetrical with no localized structural bulges or indentations visible at the skin-water interface.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; high-intensity median pixel values across the visible dorsal plane.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low spatial frequency; minimal distribution of darker pixels, localized primarily to faint linear textures on the posterior dorsal region.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient between the primary white surface and the faint, pigmented longitudinal textures.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Multiple faint, low-contrast longitudinal linear marks visible on the posterior third of the dorsal surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Faint longitudinal linear markings on the posterior dorsal surface, appearing as parallel tracks.
other_distinctive_markers: Dark circular high-contrast aperture (blowhole) visible at the anterior apex.
